title: Waffle maker
text: Waffle maker. It’s small, and not the easiest to clean. I would advise to try and clean it with damp paper towels once it’s cooled off and if needed use a little dish soap. It’s cheap of course but you can get a waffle cooked in about five minutes, and you also need to be careful of how much batter you put in because when it leaks out the side the batter will not cook and is just mushy.
